name: lizard
description: Lizard: a poker GTO study application (solution browser, trainer, analyzer, custom solving) built on the gto-solver engine.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-solver-assets.mjs && npm -w web run dev
scripts.build: node scripts/build-solver-assets.mjs && npm -w web run build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
